headline: Ex-MP Mahfuzur Rahman placed on 6-day remand in anti-terrorism case
summary: The former lawmaker from Sandwip constituency was arrested in Gulshan and faces charges related to a June 18 procession involving cocktails cocktails and anti-state slogans.
details: A Dhaka court has placed former MP Mahfuzur Rahman and his driver, Golam Maula Salim, on remand for separate durations. Rahman, who represented the Sandwip constituency, was granted a 6-day remand, while the driver was granted 5 days.
The duo were arrested by police from Gulshan on Monday night. They were subsequently booked under the Anti-Terrorism Act in a case filed at the Tejgaon Industrial Area police station on June 18.
According to the case, members of the banned Awami League and its affiliate organizations held a procession on June 18 near the Mohakhali bus terminal on Shahid Tajuddin Ahmad Sarani.
The prosecution alleges that the accused used sticks and provocative banners to shout anti-state slogans with the intent to destabilize the country and threaten public safety and sovereignty.
It is further alleged that the accused created panic among the people by detonating cocktails. Unexploded cocktails, provocative banners, and placards were recovered from the scene.
Mahfuzur Rahman was elected as a member of parliament for the Chittagong-3 (Sandwip) seat in the 2014, 2018, and 2024 national elections.
caption:
Former Sandwip MP Mahfuzur Rahman and his driver are in police custody after being arrested in Gulshan.

A Dhaka court has placed former MP Mahfuzur Rahman and his driver, Golam Maula Salim, on remand for separate durations. Rahman, who represented the Sandwip constituency, was granted a 6-day remand, while the driver was granted 5 days.

The duo were arrested by police from Gulshan on Monday night. They were subsequently booked under the Anti-Terrorism Act in a case filed at the Tejgaon Industrial Area police station on June 18.

According to the case, members of the banned Awami League and its affiliate organizations held a procession on June 18 near the Mohakhali bus terminal on Shahid Tajuddin Ahmad Sarani.

The prosecution alleges that the accused used sticks and provocative banners to shout anti-state slogans with the intent to destabilize the country and threaten public safety and sovereignty.

It is further alleged that the accused created panic among the people by detonating cocktails. Unexploded cocktails, provocative banners, and placards were recovered from the scene.

Mahfuzur Rahman was elected as a member of parliament for the Chittagong-3 (Sandwip) seat in the 2014, 2018, and 2024 national elections.

headline: Tk10 crore bridge: Bamboo used instead of rebar in Tangail
summary: A construction scandal has emerged in Basail Upazila as bamboo was found used in the slab of a bridge's footpath, leading to the dismissal of an engineer.
details: In a shocking discovery in Basail Upazila, Tangail, bamboo was used instead of steel rebar in the construction of a bridge's footpath slab.
caption:
Bamboo instead of steel? A Tk10 crore bridge project in Tangail has been exposed for using bamboo in its structure.

In a shocking discovery in Basail Upazila, Tangail, bamboo was used instead of steel rebar in the construction of a bridge's footpath slab.
